detail: Full summary: the lead's Stage 0 extraction saved only each oracle's markdown body — the structured invariants and open_questions arrays were printed to the console and never written to the oracle files, so the rulings pass found 6 of 56 question ids in the repo. Fixed by appending both lists from the workflow journal to every *.oracle.md; the 73 ruling rows in appendix B were derived from the oracles' stated defaults and stand.
